name: review
description: Comprehensive multi-phase PR review — change analysis with risk_class routing, 2-pass deep code review, risk-gated quality-review passes (domain-architecture, data-contracts, ops-reliability, change-evolution), security scanning (OWASP deepen), and documentation-drift checks, posted as one unified GitHub review. Test execution and coverage analysis are left to CI. Plus fix: apply the findings in the working tree — refactor each code smell by the named Fowler/Kerievsky move in the language's own idiom, rewrite flagged docs and comments, regenerate stale artifacts, and defer anything needing a human design decision, one commit per finding and the test suite once per partition, then push the head branch once it is green and reply to and resolve the review comments it answered. Plus monitor-pr: continuously watch a PR for CI failures and review comments (drive with /loop), delegate the fixing to fix, push, and resolve or reply-acknowledge each comment once its fix ships. Rust and mac-ui Web Components changes get tailored checks.
